ExampleDefinition.ShowcaseDescription: Visualise a directional antenna radiation pattern in full 3D alongside E-plane and H-plane polar cross-sections and a 2D gain coverage map, all driven from a single physics-based gain model.
ExampleDefinition.ToolTipDescription: Renders an antenna radiation pattern as a color-mapped 3D mesh, with E-plane and H-plane polar charts and a 2D gain coverage heatmap.
ExampleDefinition.Description:
Combines SciChart 3D and 2D chart surfaces in a single view to visualise antenna directivity.
[b]What is shown[/b]
- [b]3D Radiation Pattern[/b] - The gain of a simulated 8x8 microstrip patch array is sampled on a 180x360 spherical grid and rendered as a color-mapped 3D mesh. The mesh uses a custom [url='https://www.scichart.com/documentation/win/current/webframe.html#Extending%20SciChart%203D%20with%20Custom%20Geometry.html']BaseSceneEntity[/url] with precomputed triangles, per-vertex colors and surface normals for maximum performance.
- [b]Jet Colormap Legend[/b] - A vertical [url='https://www.scichart.com/documentation/win/current/webframe.html#HeatmapColorMap.html']HeatmapColorMap[/url] overlays the 3D chart and maps the gain range from -40 dBi (blue) to 0 dBi (red).
- [b]Gain Coverage Map[/b] - A [url='https://www.scichart.com/documentation/win/current/webframe.html#The%20Uniform%20Heatmap%20Chart%20Type.html']FastUniformHeatmapRenderableSeries[/url] shows the full gain field as a 2D heatmap. Draggable cross-section lines and a TooltipModifier let you explore exact values.
- [b]E-plane and H-plane Polar Charts[/b] - Elevation and azimuth cross-sections rendered on [url='https://www.scichart.com/documentation/win/current/webframe.html#PolarChart.html']PolarXAxis / PolarYAxis[/url] pairs. The E-plane shows gain vs theta at a fixed phi; the H-plane shows gain vs phi at a fixed theta. Both update interactively via toolbar sliders.
[b]Antenna Physics Model[/b]
The gain function combines a cos^2(theta) element factor with an 8x8 rectangular array factor (half-wavelength spacing, broadside steering). A power compression exponent of 0.75 inflates the side lobes so that all pattern features are clearly visible.
[b]Key SciChart Features[/b]
- Custom 3D geometry via BaseSceneEntity with per-vertex color and lighting - PolarXAxis / PolarYAxis for antenna pattern cross-sections - FastUniformHeatmapRenderableSeries with shared HeatmapColorPalette - HeatmapColorMap bound to a shared ColorMap for a live color scale legend - Combining SciChart3DSurface and multiple SciChartSurface instances in one view - ZAxisUp viewport orientation on SciChart3DSurface
